name: Ahmad bin Hassan
bio:
Ahmad's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during his university days, where he volunteered to help a local racing team manage their data systems. His knack for problem-solving and optimizing complex IT infrastructure quickly became invaluable. After graduation, he honed his skills in various tech companies before making a full-time leap into the motorsport world. Now, as the IT Systems Manager for Stake Sauber, Ahmad is responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of all IT systems, from telemetry data analysis to communication networks. He believes in a data-driven approach, constantly seeking innovative ways to improve efficiency and performance through technology.

Known for his meticulous approach and unflappable demeanor, Ahmad is the go-to person when critical systems face challenges. He prioritizes preventative maintenance and disaster recovery planning, ensuring the team is always prepared for the unexpected. His pragmatic approach keeps the team grounded, reminding everyone that even the most advanced technology is only as good as the people who manage it. Outside of work, Ahmad is a keen cyclist and enjoys exploring the Malaysian rainforests.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ahmad is of average height with a thoughtful expression, often seen with a slight smile.

quirks: Insists on using a physical keyboard even when working on a tablet.
Always carries a small notebook and pen for jotting down ideas, even in meetings.
Has a habit of organizing his desk with military precision.
